incident.cause: Hyper ticket retirement removed the item from the validation catalog but omitted five persisted region.fieldDrops.items entries. The region reader validated those legacy items against the filtered catalog and threw HUNT_REGION_UNAVAILABLE.
incident.responsibility: Regression introduced by the preceding Hyper activation-ticket retirement task.

permanentRepair: Filter only the retired reward before validating stored regional configuration; preserve the original raw value for compare-and-swap
Keep new configuration writes strict and all unrelated validation errors visible
Filter saved regional field pools and mixed ground bundles, preserving other loot, claim tokens and historical settled receipts
preserved: Mode ON, other regional loot settings and probabilities
Account energy, progression, currency and existing rewards
Ticket retirement: inactive catalog, zero holdings and database constraints remain in force

service.condition: Windows Node; same stored production regional policies, fixed 8ms per indexed SQL read, 10 samples. No game account writes.

coverage: Legacy five-region read with exact original CAS value and one SQL
Solo bootstrap, start, reveal, pickup, settlement, injected rollback and replay (Postgres)
Party room, readiness, start, battle, pickup, settlement, injected rollback and replay
Old mixed reward and saved claim recovery without losing remaining loot
